question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given word.

illiterate

options.text: A person who cannot read and write

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "A person who cannot read and write".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"illiterate"** means:

 
 
• A person who cannot read and write. (अशिक्षित)
 
• **Example:** Many adults in the remote village are illiterate and cannot read or write.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Opt
